title: Medical Forms — form-examples
summary: Medical forms monorepo for structured clinical assessments, patient intake, cardiovascular risk calculators, administrative healthcare documents, privacy notices, and staff training checklists. 355 form projects, each collecting data via a single-page, step-by-step questionnaire, applying a validated scoring or grading engine, and generating a clinical report with flagged issues. Every form carries a full stack: a PostgreSQL SQL schema (source of truth), generated representations (XML+DTD, FHIR HL7 R5, Protocol Buffers, OpenAPI 3.1), two front-ends (HTML and SvelteKit, both on the Lily Design System), and a Rust back-end JSON API (axum + Loco).
